title: WorldFailBench: Do World Models Understand Policy Failures?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policy evaluation informs deployment decisions and policy improvement, but physical testing and simulator preparation require substantial effort. World models offer a complementary route through closed-loop interaction in generated environments. Recent benchmarks have demonstrated their potential as policy evaluators through outcome-based evaluation (i.e., assessing task success or failure). However, such evaluation does not establish whether world models faithfully simulate how policies fail. Misrepresenting failures can lead to incorrect diagnoses of policy weaknesses and make policies appear ready for deployment even when small scene changes cause them to fail. We therefore ask: do world models faithfully simulate how and at which stages policies fail, and under what conditions they transition from success to failure? translated_title: WorldFailBench：世界模型能理解策略失败吗？
translated_abstract: 机器人策略评估为部署决策和策略改进提供依据，但物理测试和仿真器准备需要耗费大量精力。世界模型通过在生成环境中进行闭环交互，提供了一条互补的途径。近期的基准测试已经通过基于结果的评估（即评估任务的成功或失败）证明了世界模型作为策略评估器的潜力。然而，这类评估并不能证明世界模型能够忠实地模拟策略是如何失败的。对失败的错误呈现可能导致对策略弱点的错误诊断，并且即使场景的微小变化就会导致策略失败，也会使策略看起来已准备好部署。因此，我们提出这样的问题：世界模型能否忠实地模拟策略如何失败、在哪些阶段失败，以及在什么条件下从成功转变为失败？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了包含三个评估任务的WorldFailBench。失败原因（Failure reason）测试是否……
tldr: 本文提出WorldFailBench基准，超越仅评估任务结果成败的局限，用于检验世界模型能否忠实地模拟机器人策略失败的方式、阶段以及从成功到失败的转变条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WorldFailBench, a benchmark that goes beyond outcome-based evaluation to test whether world models faithfully simulate how, at which stages, and under what conditions robot policies fail.
